quotes.name: Dan, Shrewd Trader
quotes.flavor: "I love a two-for-one!"

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Hunted Wumpus
quotes.flavor: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

quotes.name: Aerial Volley
quotes.flavor: Drakes can swerve to avoid a single arrow, but they can't dodge the whole sky.

quotes.name: Warren Soultrader
quotes.flavor: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

quotes.name: Binding Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

quotes.name: Arctic Foxes
quotes.flavor:
"Those Foxes are wily, swift, and ferocious. They are the warriors of the snows."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

quotes.name: Keening Apparition
quotes.flavor: Some souls are too damaged to be of use to the Orzhov.

quotes.name: Stirring Hopesinger
quotes.flavor: Though not all her students have wings, she's determined to help them reach new heights.

quotes.name: Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: Dominaria's most ancient evil.

quotes.name: Teleportation Circle
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Pack Attack
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Kobold tactics rarely account for little things like diplomacy, mercy, or surrender.

quotes.name: Siege-Gang Commander
quotes.flavor: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

quotes.name: Astarion's Thirst
quotes.flavor:
"Stop bleeding. It's distracting."
—Astarion, the Decadent

quotes.name: Rod of Ruin
quotes.flavor: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

quotes.name: Crop Rotation
quotes.flavor: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

quotes.name: Spider-Sense
quotes.flavor: "My spider-sense—it's tingling! Something behind me!"

quotes.name: Jester's Cap
quotes.flavor:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Byway Barterer
quotes.flavor: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

quotes.name: Obsessive Stitcher
quotes.flavor: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
"Model? I'm insulted. It's by all reasonable metrics a fully functional planetary system, scaled down for easier study."
—Urza, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Xanthic Statue
quotes.flavor:
"Until you have lived as a statue, do not talk to me of pigeons."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Ravenous Harpy
quotes.flavor: A harpy's hoard is a filthy, bloodstained pile of trinkets and corpses.

quotes.name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
quotes.flavor: "Sometimes, we must make our own path through the darkness."

quotes.name: Vengeful Reaper
quotes.flavor: "Starnheim is closed to you, coward."

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"Una vez vi a un trasgo gritándole a una tormenta eléctrica. Perdió la discusión bastante rápido."
—Mago errante

quotes.name: Clarion Cathars
quotes.flavor: The sound of the trumpet is both warning and comfort: it tells of approaching danger but also reminds the village folk that someone is there to stand against it.

quotes.name: Furnace Whelp
quotes.flavor: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

quotes.name: Lone Missionary
quotes.flavor: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

quotes.name: Might Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Glass Casket
quotes.flavor: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

quotes.name: Sylvan Bounty
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.

quotes.name: Zhuge Jin, Wu Strategist
quotes.flavor: When Zhuge Jin proposed the marriage of Guan Yu's daugher and Sun Quan's heir, Guan Yu's arrogant refusal led to disaster.

quotes.name: Port Town
quotes.flavor:
"I think you'll find that our little island will make an ideal base for your Quinjets!"
—Stingray, Walter Newell

quotes.name: Piracy
quotes.flavor: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.

quotes.name: Sea Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, sea troll

quotes.name: Branching Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Lightning lives in everything, in living flesh and growing things. It must be set free."
—Rakka Mar

quotes.name: Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer
quotes.flavor: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

quotes.name: Sunder from Within
quotes.flavor: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

quotes.name: Wake the Past
quotes.flavor: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

quotes.name: Devils' Playground
quotes.flavor:
"The city is overrun. I would say burn it to the ground, but that won't be necessary."
—Inquisitor Delmund

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

quotes.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
quotes.flavor: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

quotes.name: Run Ashore
quotes.flavor:
"Which one of you slug-brained milksops forgot to make an offering to Cosima?"
—Jolkur, navigator

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

quotes.name: Icatian Town
quotes.flavor: Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

quotes.name: Great Sable Stag
quotes.flavor: Ineffable and incorruptible.

quotes.name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
quotes.flavor: Recent rumors speak of an impostor that shows up and masquerades as Siegfried himself.

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: The road appeared lonely and forsaken, running down to empty ruins in the mist. But there was an evil feeling in the air.

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor: Even worse, the only toilet paper was locked in a nearby safe.

quotes.name: Stolen Grain
quotes.flavor: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot, leaving him with no way to feed his troops.

quotes.name: Kellogg, Dangerous Mind
quotes.flavor: "We both know how this will end. So... you ready?"

quotes.name: Lotus Cobra
quotes.flavor: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor:
"That which knows itself cannot be shaped to another's will."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Jackknight
quotes.flavor: "My sword is at your service, as are my scissors, corkscrew, and bottle opener."

quotes.name: Tegwyll's Scouring
quotes.flavor: "Your season has ended. We are eternal."

quotes.name: Kor Spiritdancer
quotes.flavor: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

quotes.name: Browbeat
quotes.flavor:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

quotes.name: Rhonas's Last Stand
quotes.flavor: Rhonas continued to fight until his last breath and even beyond.

quotes.name: Mindspring Merfolk
quotes.flavor: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: The Battle of Baal was the bloodiest and most costly in the entire noble history of the Sons of Sanguinius.

quotes.name: Diving Griffin
quotes.flavor:
To outrace the griffin
—Kipamu expression meaning "to do the impossible"

quotes.name: Douse in Gloom
quotes.flavor: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.

quotes.name: Minamo's Meddling
quotes.flavor: Like storm water through the segments of bamboo, the spell followed the links of magic. Then it destroyed them.

quotes.name: Mirran Crusader
quotes.flavor: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Upon scattering her grandmother's ashes, the Envoy was bathed in a warm spectral glow.

quotes.name: Infest
quotes.flavor:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

quotes.name: Butcher of Malakir
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

quotes.name: Vexing Shusher
quotes.flavor: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

quotes.name: Redemption Arc
quotes.flavor: Crime doesn't pay nearly as well as the Agency.

quotes.name: Mind's Eye
quotes.flavor: Developed and tested by researchers at the Consulate's House of Knowledge, these devices allow anyone to see with a visionary's eye.

quotes.name: Teach by Example
quotes.flavor:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

quotes.name: Crushing Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

quotes.name: Supreme Verdict
quotes.flavor:
"I'll grant that the siege engines are gone, but do you think that might have been a bit of overkill?"
—Sergeant Malsworth

quotes.name: Combine Chrysalis
quotes.flavor:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Impounding Lot-Bot
quotes.flavor: Not all tickets can be exchanged for prizes.

quotes.name: Suppression Bonds
quotes.flavor:
"A master of hieromancy can see the advantage in any scenario."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

quotes.name: Humble Defector
quotes.flavor:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

quotes.name: Faramir, Field Commander
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "A chance for Faramir, Captain of Gondor, to show his quality."

quotes.name: Ageless Guardian
quotes.flavor: Ancient ruins dot the world of Arcavios, most older than Strixhaven itself and many still guarded by soldiers from the Blood Age, centuries after their deaths.

quotes.name: Merchant of the Vale // Haggle
quotes.flavor: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

quotes.name: Birthing Boughs
quotes.flavor: Changelings can't remember where they came from. They just know it wasn't a cradle.

quotes.name: Valorous Stance
quotes.flavor:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Gilt-Leaf Seer
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories. The act only deepened their insight.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Bereaved Survivor // Dauntless Avenger
quotes.flavor: "With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to. Alone, I wept for a sister who would never return."

quotes.name: Vassal Soul
quotes.flavor: For the Azorius, the opportunity to serve the law is too great an honor for death to interrupt.

quotes.name: Steady Progress
quotes.flavor: "More of that strange oil . . . It's probably nothing."

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor: The vaults of the Necron Dynasties contain all manner of esoteric artifacts, most forged long before many of the younger races even existed.

quotes.name: Armor Thrull
quotes.flavor:
"The worst thing about being a mercenary for the Ebon Hand is having to wear a dead thrull."
—Ivra Jursdotter

quotes.name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
quotes.flavor: "Rikku-approved item coming up!"

quotes.name: D'Avenant Healer
quotes.flavor: "One arrow keenly fired might prevent more battlefield wounds than I could treat."

quotes.name: Boggart Prankster
quotes.flavor:
"Fetch my bow! And an umbrella!"
—Edren, kithkin farmer

quotes.name: Strix Serenade
quotes.flavor: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor:
"And topples round the dreary west
A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

quotes.name: Tyvar's Stand
quotes.flavor: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."

quotes.name: Huang Zhong, Shu General
quotes.flavor: "Virile in war, he kept the north in fear; His prodigies subdued the western sphere."

quotes.name: Magus of the Mirror
quotes.flavor: "Behold! The image of the enemy and all that she has. Trust your envy, and take it."

quotes.name: Master Decoy
quotes.flavor: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Vampire Interloper
quotes.flavor: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory. Their agents arrive from the sky to collect the ceremonial bowls in eerie silence.

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor:
"My vibranium Hulkbuster absorbs and amplifies energy, Hulk. I'd advise you to calm down."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Protean Thaumaturge
quotes.flavor: "Once you see past the veil we call 'reality,' altering your own shape is elementary."

quotes.name: Birthday Escape
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: As Bilbo finished his speech, he slipped the ring on his finger, and he was never seen by any Hobbit in Hobbiton again.

quotes.name: Feral Abomination
quotes.flavor:
"Urborg used to be lovely—scenic volcanoes, respectable lich lords. Since the Cabal came with their nightmares and thrulls, it's all gone to the worms."
—Mister Lostspoons, Skulltown gossip

quotes.name: Chastise
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Goblin War Paint
quotes.flavor: War paint made from kolya fruit heightens senses and lessens fear. Unfortunately, fear is usually what keeps you alive.

quotes.name: Pelakka Wurm
quotes.flavor: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

quotes.name: Rolling Thunder
quotes.flavor:
"Zendikar is always angry, though I've never seen that anger so precisely directed."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

quotes.name: Tree of Perdition
quotes.flavor: A haunted husk of bark, its cursed whispers linger on the wind.

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: Once a symbol of hope, now a sinister reminder.

quotes.name: Bound in Silence
quotes.flavor: A fight put off forever is already won.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Howling Mine
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

quotes.name: Ancestral Recall
quotes.flavor: 2022 Europe Vintage Championship

quotes.name: Dragon Hatchling
quotes.flavor:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

quotes.name: Rumbling Ruin
quotes.flavor: The Rubblebelt grows restless.

quotes.name: Helpful Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

quotes.name: Thassa's Intervention
quotes.flavor: "I bring a flood that nothing can withstand."

quotes.name: Opulent Palace
quotes.flavor: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

quotes.name: Bloodhunter Bat
quotes.flavor: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
quotes.flavor: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

quotes.name: Solve the Equation
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever Tezzeret is working with is after more than the Emperor."
—Tamiyo

quotes.name: Exclude
quotes.flavor:
"Terrifying, but thankfully temporary."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor:
"When it starts, I won't be myself any more. I won't be able to hold myself back."
—Jecht

quotes.name: Heroic Defiance
quotes.flavor:
"Wear courage as your armor. Wield honor as your blade."
—Gerrard

quotes.name: Locthwain Lancer
quotes.flavor: For years she believed persistence meant hunting for the Cauldron of Eternity. Now she knew it meant never giving up the fight against a world gone mad.

quotes.name: Arbor Elf
quotes.flavor: "Dead crowd tonight."

quotes.name: Nature's Claim
quotes.flavor:
"On this plane, the use of magic can provoke a ferocious reprisal from nature. Whoever the Eldrazi were, their relics left Zendikar forever enraged."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Blight Mound
quotes.flavor: Pests feed on carrion, mud, and one another.

quotes.name: Trade Routes
quotes.flavor: The wise, the righteous, the mighty—the merchant feeds them all.

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"Today there is feasting and peace across our land, but the war has not ended. Tuck away your bloodlust. You'll need it tomorrow."
—Karrim, Samite healer

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Terashi's Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

quotes.name: Banishing Light
quotes.flavor:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

quotes.name: Dragon's Claw
quotes.flavor: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
quotes.flavor: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

quotes.name: Reign of Chaos
quotes.flavor:
"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Tajuru Warcaller
quotes.flavor: Her rallying cry reaches far beyond the Tajuru elves, inspiring all those who hear it.

quotes.name: Devouring Light
quotes.flavor: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

quotes.name: Orzhov Racketeers
quotes.flavor: "Looks like you need protection."

quotes.name: Deputy of Acquittals
quotes.flavor: "Everyone deserves a day in court."

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Font of Agonies
quotes.flavor:
"No worthwhile reward is easily gained."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Flame Blitz
quotes.flavor: "Blast it, not again!"

quotes.name: Thriving Turtle
quotes.flavor: Aether shapes everything on Kaladesh, from the sky to the sea.

quotes.name: Divine Offering
quotes.flavor: These tears of pain I weep to the skies, Not bitter drops, but water made divine. Each gem of sorrow slips, no longer mine, But proffered thus to echo other cries.

quotes.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
quotes.flavor: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

quotes.name: Morbid Curiosity
quotes.flavor: "Every creation carries a piece of its creators. Their knowledge, their dreams, their soul. That is the best part."

quotes.name: A.I.M. Synthoids
quotes.flavor: "M.O.D.O.K.—commands—that—you—be—neutralized! Nothing—must—interfere—with—our—programmed—mission!"

quotes.name: Fungal Sprouting
quotes.flavor:
"Saprolings need only a host to feed upon. Numbers will take care of the rest."
—Ghave, Guru of Spores

quotes.name: Whiptongue Hydra
quotes.flavor:
"Where'd all the birds go?"
—Kaldrin, jungle sightseer

quotes.name: Vampiric Feast
quotes.flavor: It's not always gold the thief is after.

quotes.name: Child of Night
quotes.flavor: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor: Using their stolen Time Scepter—with total command of time and space—Bebop and Rocksteady departed for Prehistoric Earth in search of "somethin' big ta wrassle."

quotes.name: Blade Historian
quotes.flavor: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."

quotes.name: Pernicious Deed
quotes.flavor: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

quotes.name: Descendant of Kiyomaro
quotes.flavor: "The blood of Kiyomaro flows in my veins. He did not let Eiganjo fall and neither shall I."

quotes.name: Slippery Bogle
quotes.flavor: During the Invasion, the Phyrexians agreed there were some things that were not worth *compleating*.

quotes.name: Valakut Awakening // Valakut Stoneforge
quotes.flavor:
"I can hear the echo of their hammers, long stilled."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

quotes.name: Sporemound
quotes.flavor:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Invade the City
quotes.flavor: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.

quotes.name: Goblin Spymaster
quotes.flavor:
"Infiltrate and infuriate!"
—Goblin Espionage League motto

quotes.name: Assembled Alphas
quotes.flavor: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

quotes.name: Frilled Sandwalla
quotes.flavor:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Incinerate
quotes.flavor:
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'"
—Akin, seasoned askari

quotes.name: Inspiring Leader
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Your family needed a farmer, so you tilled. Your town needed a fighter, so you trained. When your people needed a leader, you knew what you had to do.

quotes.name: Jayemdae Tome
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge is power."
—Sir Francis Bacon, *Meditationes Sacrae*

quotes.name: Crimson Hellkite
quotes.flavor:
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

quotes.name: Qarsi Revenant
quotes.flavor:
"Evil wears many faces. Keep your windows closed at night, or it might wear yours."
—Sultai warning

quotes.name: Key to the City
quotes.flavor: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: The choice isn't whether to eat, but when to stop.

quotes.name: Pathbreaker Ibex
quotes.flavor:
"My skills are wasted here."
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

quotes.name: Ridgetop Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

quotes.name: Archmage Emeritus
quotes.flavor: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

quotes.name: Dominus of Fealty
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing is truly your own. It is his, whether you know it or not."
—*The Seer's Parables*

quotes.name: Plague Witch
quotes.flavor: "I can ail what cures you."

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Argivian Phalanx
quotes.flavor: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

quotes.name: The Ozolith
quotes.flavor: As it twists, so does all life around it.

quotes.name: Time Warp
quotes.flavor: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

quotes.name: Inspiring Statuary
quotes.flavor: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

quotes.name: Baki's Curse
quotes.flavor:
"Those who fling spells too quickly should have reason to regret it."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

quotes.name: Sudden Impact
quotes.flavor: Caught red-handed.

quotes.name: Nissa's Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Scattered Groves
quotes.flavor:
"We'll be safe over there. Safe from the Cheetahs, and the Master."
—The Seventh Doctor

quotes.name: Captain Lannery Storm
quotes.flavor: "I believe in love at first shine."

quotes.name: Pol Jamaar, Illusionist
quotes.flavor: "'Real' is a more flexible concept than you might think."

quotes.name: Ultimate Price
quotes.flavor:
"The realization that one is dying is far more terrifying than death itself."
—Sidisi, Silumgar vizier

quotes.name: Grim Monolith
quotes.flavor: Part prison, part home.

quotes.name: Bastion Protector
quotes.flavor: "By this oath, I pledge to stand by thee, against traitor, beast, or fiend, for only in death does duty end."

quotes.name: Harvest Hand // Scrounged Scythe
quotes.flavor: The harvest is never finished.

quotes.name: Voltaic Key
quotes.flavor: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

quotes.name: Seam Rip
quotes.flavor: Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.

quotes.name: Signal Pest
quotes.flavor: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

quotes.name: Hooting Mandrills
quotes.flavor: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Armageddon
quotes.flavor: War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.

quotes.name: Bladebrand
quotes.flavor:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith, the Scourge Diva

quotes.name: Ninja's Kunai
quotes.flavor: A point to pierce flesh and spirit alike.

quotes.name: Desperate Ravings
quotes.flavor: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor:
"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Bloodchief's Thirst
quotes.flavor: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."

quotes.name: Murasa Behemoth
quotes.flavor: The loss of its hunting grounds made it all the more dangerous.

quotes.name: Eyeblight Massacre
quotes.flavor:
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"
—Nissa Revane, to Dwynen

quotes.name: Briber's Purse
quotes.flavor: Victory is certain. The price, negotiable.

quotes.name: Lhurgoyf
quotes.flavor:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Spider-UK
quotes.flavor: "Spiders across the Multiverse are dying. I must keep them safe."

quotes.name: Attentive Sunscribe
quotes.flavor: Few humans are steady-handed enough to match a gnome's precision. Even the slightest change to a single line can wildly alter a glyph's meaning.

quotes.name: Elemental Bond
quotes.flavor:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Jaws of Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"The Jeskai like talking about their Way? Let's see them talk their way out of this dilemma."
—Girdah, Abzan beastrider

quotes.name: Silent Arbiter
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

quotes.name: Gingerbrute
quotes.flavor: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Infiltrator
quotes.flavor:
"It is Yawgmoth's will incarnate: an efficient machine that replaces inefficient flesh."
—Tsabo Tavoc

quotes.name: Boarded Window
quotes.flavor:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

quotes.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
quotes.flavor: The ghouls of the FMS *Northern Star* seemed interested in moving up in the world of business.

quotes.name: Sacred Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Fiery Fall
quotes.flavor: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

quotes.name: Taranika, Akroan Veteran
quotes.flavor: "I like to think Kytheon keeps watch over all of us."

quotes.name: Elven Cache
quotes.flavor: Elves know where to harvest the best of the forest, for they planted it themselves.

quotes.name: Sift
quotes.flavor:
"Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Zealous Persecution
quotes.flavor: "Rejoice! Your vile blood will help fulfill our righteous cause."

quotes.name: Incendiary Flow
quotes.flavor: "What's your plan?" Gideon asked. "Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

quotes.name: Insurrection
quotes.flavor:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

quotes.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

quotes.name: Sacrifice
quotes.flavor: Cultists eagerly undergo the Rite of the Threshold, allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.

quotes.name: Lingering Souls
quotes.flavor: The landlord drove off the elderly couple to repossess their home. Eventually, the couple possessed it back.

quotes.name: Wandering Archaic // Explore the Vastlands
quotes.flavor: "Fly the path of nine birds."

quotes.name: Twilight Mire
quotes.flavor: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

quotes.name: Assassinate
quotes.flavor:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

quotes.name: Wrath of God
quotes.flavor:
"As flies to wanton boys, are we to the gods. They kill us for their sport."
—William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

quotes.name: Thran Golem
quotes.flavor: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

quotes.name: Grindstone
quotes.flavor:
"All attempts to halt the machine failed. We must find a way to repurpose it."
—Consulate engineer's log

quotes.name: Pattern Matcher
quotes.flavor:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Abyssal Horror
quotes.flavor: It has no face of its own—it wears that of its latest victim.

quotes.name: Jolrael's Centaur
quotes.flavor:
"What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?"
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

quotes.name: Bloodbond Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Strangled Cemetery
quotes.flavor: They say that with each new moon, the buried dead rise and dance from dusk to dawn, and witnesses to the revelry must join them for eternity.

quotes.name: Scatter the Seeds
quotes.flavor: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

quotes.name: Wall of Reverence
quotes.flavor: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

quotes.name: Magmaquake
quotes.flavor:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

quotes.name: Burnt Offering
quotes.flavor: *"The Wicker Man," single (2000)*

quotes.name: Dwarven Lieutenant
quotes.flavor:
"Dwarven officers were tireless in battle, moving up and down the lines to rally their troops and boost morale."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor:
Your heart's desire is found within.
—Saddlebag inscription

quotes.name: Tajuru Snarecaster
quotes.flavor: Elves of the Tajuru Nation spend their lives in the ancient jaddi trees' expansive canopy, some living and dying without ever touching the ground.

quotes.name: Slith Firewalker
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

quotes.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
quotes.flavor: "This is my battle, one I must fight alone to atone for my wrongs."

quotes.name: Chimeric Idol
quotes.flavor: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

quotes.name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
quotes.flavor: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Silvercoat Lion
quotes.flavor:
"In the wild, white fur like mine is an aberration. We lack natural camouflage, but the inability to hide encourages other strengths."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Mirage Mirror
quotes.flavor: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

quotes.name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
quotes.flavor: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

quotes.name: Warriors' Lesson
quotes.flavor:
"Let each challenge make you a better warrior."
—Anthousa of Setessa

quotes.name: Primal Might
quotes.flavor: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

quotes.name: Kodama's Reach
quotes.flavor:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Elvish Ranger
quotes.flavor:
"No one may fault an Elvish Ranger's heart, but the simplest frailty may fell even the proudest warrior."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Blur Sliver
quotes.flavor: They move in a synchronized swarm, turning entire squads into heaps of bloody rags and bones in an instant.

quotes.name: Elven Farsight
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Incite Insight
quotes.flavor: After a hundred failed patent applications, Cornelian was stunned to find that no one had ever created a steam-powered autonomous ice cream delivery system. He immediately designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

quotes.name: Soulmender
quotes.flavor: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Oblivion Sower
quotes.flavor: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

quotes.name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
quotes.flavor: "I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."

quotes.name: Yet Another Aether Vortex
quotes.flavor: It puts the "vortex" in "flavortext."

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Reverent Howl
quotes.flavor: The grey chief spoke in their dreadful language, and every now and then all the Wargs in the circle would answer together.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Obliterator
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred

quotes.name: Anthroplasm
quotes.flavor: I never metamorphosis I didn't like.

quotes.name: Renegade Firebrand
quotes.flavor: "For freedom! For fame! For fire!"

quotes.name: Squall
quotes.flavor:
"May the winds blow till they have wakened death. . . ."
—William Shakespeare,
*Othello*

quotes.name: Curious Pair // Treats to Share
quotes.flavor: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

quotes.name: Mordenkainen's Polymorph
quotes.flavor: "Your purpose may change along with your shape, but you will serve regardless."

quotes.name: Cleaving Sliver
quotes.flavor: When it wriggled closer to a thrum of slivers, their talons hardened and glinted in the sun. One took a playful swipe at a tree trunk, and its new blade cut clean through.

quotes.name: Dawn of Hope
quotes.flavor:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

quotes.name: Kari Zev's Expertise
quotes.flavor: "I was made for this!"

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Ostracize
quotes.flavor: Kerrick was to find that some borders can never be crossed.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"It's me and Gribble's special fort. None of the bad things can get us in there."
—Toby

quotes.name: Loyal Guardian
quotes.flavor: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

quotes.name: Sledding Otter-Penguin
quotes.flavor: Otter-penguins often play with humans, carrying them on their backs as they sled down snowy embankments.

quotes.name: Surge of Thoughtweft
quotes.flavor: Kithkin weave together their very thoughts, creating a depth of cooperation unknown to other races.

quotes.name: Idolized
quotes.flavor: Renowned for your extensive support and goodwill, you are idolized by the community.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The same muscles used to swing a sword can be used to feed a burrow.

quotes.name: Grim Lavamancer
quotes.flavor: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

quotes.name: Diligent Excavator
quotes.flavor: Archaeologists don't just dig in the dirt. They excavate time, scraping off the years grain by grain.

quotes.name: Giltgrove Stalker
quotes.flavor: "The only gold I need is the sheltering shimmer of the trees."

quotes.name: Don't Make a Sound
quotes.flavor: Jace kept his mouth shut, but he couldn't shake the feeling that the strange creatures could hear the screaming in his mind.

quotes.name: Early Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty:
Vines with clust'ring bunches growing;
Plants with goodly burden bowing."
—William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

quotes.name: Flames of the Firebrand
quotes.flavor:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Abbey Gargoyles
quotes.flavor:
"Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."
—Gulsen, abbey matron

quotes.name: Goblin Chirurgeon
quotes.flavor: The Chirurgeons patched up their fallen comrades with a gruesome mix of twisted limbs and mangled flesh.

quotes.name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
quotes.flavor: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Coast
quotes.flavor: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

quotes.name: Barkchannel Pathway // Tidechannel Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Trust in the path, and it will bear you to safety."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

quotes.name: Burnished Hart
quotes.flavor: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

quotes.name: Tribal Unity
quotes.flavor: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him, but he still believes in the power of muscle.

quotes.name: Bone Saw
quotes.flavor:
"When metal instruments are scarce, a saw constructed from the subject's femur will suffice for a craniectomy."
—Ashnod, research notes

quotes.name: Vernal Fen
quotes.flavor:
"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

quotes.name: Insight
quotes.flavor:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Aradara Express
quotes.flavor: It glides around the city, a sublime combination of elegance and utility.

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Fallen Angel
quotes.flavor:
"Angels are simply extensions of truth upon the fabric of life—and there is far more dark than light."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: No Rest for the Wicked
quotes.flavor:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

quotes.name: Vicious Conquistador
quotes.flavor:
"He is ambitious. Tireless. And utterly ruthless. Ideal for the frontier."
—Viceroy Elia Sotonores, report to the queen

quotes.name: Brittle Effigy
quotes.flavor:
"In my early experiments in phylactery, I found that fragile forms have their uses."
—Rocati, Duke of Martyne

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor:
"If anyone is reading this, this place isn't safe anymore."
—Hunter's warning note

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

quotes.name: Ground Seal
quotes.flavor:
"They laid her to rest in the wilds, in a sacred place beyond the reach of nightmares or machines."
—*The Nameless Knight of Summer*

quotes.name: Nature's Lore
quotes.flavor:
"The spirits that return to the planet, merge with one another and roam the planet. They roam, converge, and divide, becoming a swell, called the lifestream."
—Bugenhagen

quotes.name: Young Wolf
quotes.flavor: Good archers kill in one shot. Great archers confirm with two.

quotes.name: Curse of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: The first step to peace is to learn how to forget.

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

quotes.name: Kiora's Dambreaker
quotes.flavor:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Run Out of Town
quotes.flavor: Better to depart in haste than be dearly departed.

quotes.name: Scrounging Skyray
quotes.flavor: "Oi, you ain't gonna believe what these kelpheads just threw away!"

quotes.name: Daraja Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

quotes.name: Malevolent Witchkite
quotes.flavor:
"Was there a fearsome witch around here? Or was it a cruel dragon? The tales were confu—oh no."
—Osval, adventurer

quotes.name: Stun
quotes.flavor:
"I concede it was a cheap shot, but it was the only one I could afford."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

quotes.name: Force of Will
quotes.flavor: "Your artillery will burn itself out before I allow my focus to waver."

quotes.name: Blur Sliver
quotes.flavor: Traveling across the desert alone, you might assume you'd see them coming, but that would be your third mistake.

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"The lotus is a potent but ephemeral source of power. To preserve its potency, lacquer carefully with a conductive coating."
—*Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II*

quotes.name: Quenchable Fire
quotes.flavor: You'd better know how to pray for rain.

quotes.name: Spined Basher
quotes.flavor:
"How cute. Does it do any other tricks?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
quotes.flavor: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Rakdos Headliner
quotes.flavor: Mood: Unrestrained violence in a festival atmosphere.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

quotes.name: Trumpet Blast
quotes.flavor:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Haunted Mire
quotes.flavor: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

quotes.name: Delightful Discovery
quotes.flavor: "What do you think? New class pet?"

quotes.name: Two-Headed Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"That which would be a fatal mutation in any other species is merely a source of new powers. I am intrigued, yet too fearful to examine it more closely."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Feast of the Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"Some delicacies are not to be savored, save by the callous."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Fateful Showdown
quotes.flavor: Tonight at the Grand Exhibition, witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar.

quotes.name: Blood Bairn
quotes.flavor: The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.

quotes.name: Promise of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: "It's us against the world. Forever."

quotes.name: Vryn Wingmare
quotes.flavor: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

quotes.name: Bounty of Might
quotes.flavor:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Eliminate the Impossible
quotes.flavor: "Half the city had motive. Time to narrow down who also had the means and opportunity."

quotes.name: Omen Hawker
quotes.flavor: After years of fabricating visions for naive customers of the Obscura, Stafano was flummoxed by the nightmarish scenes that played out unbidden in his mind's eye.

quotes.name: Scarecrone
quotes.flavor: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

quotes.name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
quotes.flavor:
"Lat-Nam has bequeathed us its secrets. With them we shall attain true enlightenment."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Board the Weatherlight
quotes.flavor: A new gathering for a new age.

quotes.name: Eternal Warrior
quotes.flavor: Warriors of the Tsunami-nito School spend years in training to master the way of effortless effort.

quotes.name: Slab Hammer
quotes.flavor: Neither subtle nor pretty.

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: His presence brings not only a strong arm but also renewed hope.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Redoubled Stormsinger
quotes.flavor: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

quotes.name: Unearth
quotes.flavor: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

quotes.name: First Come, First Served
quotes.flavor: Yotian soldiers hoped that one day R&D would make an artifact creature whose name starts with Z. And in their dreams, it's a 4/1.

quotes.name: Fog
quotes.flavor: It's hard enough to find your way through uncharted wilderness when you can see the tip of your nose.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

quotes.name: Sacred Boon
quotes.flavor:
"Divine gifts are granted to those who are worthy."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

quotes.name: Narnam Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I do not need to pierce your heart to still its beating."

quotes.name: Military Intelligence
quotes.flavor: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

quotes.name: Yuyan Archers
quotes.flavor:
"Their precision is legendary. The Yuyan can pin a fly to a tree from a hundred yards away without killing it."
—Admiral Zhao

quotes.name: Ogre Warrior
quotes.flavor: Assault and battery included.

quotes.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

quotes.name: Joyous Respite
quotes.flavor:
"I have been gifted by the kami with long life. So far, they have not seen fit to withdraw their gift. There may yet be a way to stop the killing without more blood, human or kami, being spilled."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Knighthood
quotes.flavor: Kings don't make knights. Actions do.

quotes.name: Fangorn, Tree Shepherd
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I am an Ent. Fangorn is my name according to some, Treebeard others make it."

quotes.name: Summer Bloom
quotes.flavor: "All the treasures of this world are grown, not made."

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

quotes.name: Loxodon Convert
quotes.flavor: Just one drop of the glistening oil can eventually stain even a soul as stalwart as a loxodon's beyond redemption.

quotes.name: Gas Guzzler
quotes.flavor: Gastal's vampires took fuel from the dead.

quotes.name: Mantle of Webs
quotes.flavor:
"Why does everything the Golgari touch end up sticky?"
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Chilling Apparition
quotes.flavor: Mortal minds shrivel at its touch.

quotes.name: 70,000 Light-Years from Home
quotes.flavor:
"If these sensors are working . . . we're on the other side of the Galaxy."
—Ensign Harry Kim

quotes.name: Avenging Hunter
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "I will remember my friends. But you? You won't be remembered at all."

quotes.name: Treasure Hunt
quotes.flavor:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: River of Tears
quotes.flavor:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: Llanowar covers a million square miles, yet nobody enters the forest without the elves knowing it.

quotes.name: Earth Tremor
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Every cave-in is Moradin telling you to leave the earth where it is."
—Halgar, dwarven recluse

quotes.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
quotes.flavor:
"About, about in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Atlantean Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
"These surface dwellers feel safe with their feet on dry land. Let us remind them why they fear the deep water."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor:
"By the time you've seen it all, all have already changed."
—Wandering treant, name unknown

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.flavor: "Pssst pssst Pinkie pssst pssst pssst cake pssst pssst top secret . . ."

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: When you sink a lot of ships, it's easy to find sunken treasure.

quotes.name: Zodiac Dog
quotes.flavor: ". . . Jiang Wei alone still strove with might and main: / Nine times more he fought the north—in vain. . . ."

quotes.name: Pestilent Wolf
quotes.flavor: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

quotes.name: Brainstone
quotes.flavor: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

quotes.name: Forsaken Monument
quotes.flavor:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: Remote but always watching, the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.flavor: He knew there was no way back home, back to Zanarkand.

quotes.name: Kird Ape
quotes.flavor: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

quotes.name: Eager Construct
quotes.flavor: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

quotes.name: Jade Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

quotes.name: Mind Twist
quotes.flavor: The doubt expunged, the walls restored, memory molded like clay.

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

quotes.name: Supply Caravan
quotes.flavor:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

quotes.name: Tangled Florahedron // Tangled Vale
quotes.flavor:
"As Bala Ged regrows, new forms of life blossom with unfettered wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

quotes.name: Rotting Regisaur
quotes.flavor:
"Now, *that's* a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

quotes.name: Loamdragger Giant
quotes.flavor: Giants sleep soundly and long, sometimes for long enough that a crust of earth and moss grows over them. But inevitably something disturbs their slumber, and they wake unhappy.

quotes.name: Dryad Greenseeker
quotes.flavor: "The land already knows its destiny. I simply ask it to share the tale with me."

quotes.name: Kyren Negotiations
quotes.flavor: Kyren goblins always speak in questions and never allow wrong answers.

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Devout Lightcaster
quotes.flavor:
"Goddess, grant us light to banish the world's shadows."
—Prayer to Kamsa

quotes.name: Irreverent Revelers
quotes.flavor: To some satyrs, only blasphemy is sacred.

quotes.name: Flowstone Blade
quotes.flavor:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Iron Lad, Young Avenger
quotes.flavor: "I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."

quotes.name: Adherent of Hope
quotes.flavor: "Basri has shown me the way forward, and I will follow."

quotes.name: Sol Ring
Startling Development
quotes.flavor: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.

quotes.name: Always Watching
quotes.flavor:
"We pray to Avacyn on high. On snow-white wings fearless you fly. Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives. May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

quotes.name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second // Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
quotes.flavor: "Mister Mittens, you would not be-*lieve* the day I had."

quotes.name: Loyal Drake
quotes.flavor:
"Doves and pigeons are too subtle. When I send a message, I want it to have some teeth."
—Aeschel, royal diplomat

quotes.name: Nightmarish End
quotes.flavor:
"To think some believe it peaceful to die in one's sleep."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

quotes.name: Gallantry
quotes.flavor: "Forgive me," Mirri whispered. "I thought you a burden, and you saved my life." Hanna quietly accepted the apology.

quotes.name: Saruman the White
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Sauron's victory is at hand; and there will be rich reward for those who aided it."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Tyranny
quotes.flavor:
"He is Yawgmoth's reward to me. I shall kill him a hundred times a day."
—Crovax, to Ertai

quotes.name: Heir of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: In the high caves of the Qal Sisma mountains, young hunters quest to hear the echoes of their fierce ancestors.

quotes.name: Tar Pitcher
quotes.flavor:
"Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms. At the same time, her warren decided to share with her a sensory greeting of hot tar . . . ."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

quotes.name: Harmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Bottomless Pit
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, we'll win this game the old-fashioned way, the tried-and-true way: we'll cheat!"
—Skeletor

quotes.name: Desolation Twin
quotes.flavor:
"With precise coordination and enough blood spilled, one can be driven off, even brought down. But two . . . that's a lot of blood."
—Munda, ambush leader

quotes.name: Drillworks Mole
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The Flaming Fist soldiers prepared to face a bulette, or worse, but the cause of the rumblings turned out to be much more benign and bizarre.

quotes.name: Stinging Hivemaster
quotes.flavor: From within its form, a single word echoed forth: "Devour."

quotes.name: Strangleroot Geist
quotes.flavor: Geists of the hanged often haunt the tree on which they died.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
"It's time for you to fulfill your destiny."
—Princess Celestia

quotes.name: Carnage Tyrant
quotes.flavor: Outsiders may marvel at the Sun Empire's "domesticated" dinosaurs, but those who live alongside them know they can never truly be tamed.

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, how I love gold. I'd eat and breathe it if I could."
—Leland, tax collector

quotes.name: Dragonloft Idol
quotes.flavor: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

quotes.name: Deadeye Navigator
quotes.flavor: The navigator guides the ship. The bird guides the navigator.

quotes.name: Greed
quotes.flavor: An advisor once asked the Western Paladin how much gold would be enough. "I have no need of fools who can imagine 'enough,'" he told the advisor's corpse.

quotes.name: Battlefield Promotion
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

quotes.name: Canopy Gargantuan
quotes.flavor: Its very presence forces nature to adapt.

quotes.name: Typhoid Rats
quotes.flavor: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

quotes.name: Divine Visitation
quotes.flavor: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: Dissolutions Increasing—Are Varmints to Blame?

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Razorverge Thicket
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

quotes.name: Pyrite Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Big Play
quotes.flavor:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: An-Havva Township
quotes.flavor: Folk of good heart will always find a home.

quotes.name: Gift of Granite
quotes.flavor: The blessing adds both protection to the recipient and weightlessness to the stone.

quotes.name: Reminisce
quotes.flavor: Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges.

quotes.name: Shenanigans
quotes.flavor: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

quotes.name: Swift Kick
quotes.flavor: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

quotes.name: Coastal Tower
quotes.flavor: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

quotes.name: Riptide Mangler
quotes.flavor: It wants you to be its chum.

quotes.name: Ruby Medallion
quotes.flavor: It is the warm glow of the setting sun at journey's end, the scent of the evening meal crackling over a fire, and the cacophony of a raucous song shared over tankards of mead. It is freedom.

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

quotes.name: Sunset Pyramid
quotes.flavor: Decades to build. Hours to demolish.

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

quotes.name: Surge Conductor
quotes.flavor: A conductor for an electric symphony.

quotes.name: Starlit Angel
quotes.flavor: To soar as high as hope, to dive as swift as justice.

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: Two-Headed Giant
quotes.flavor: He watches the pass in both directions, and all must pay his toll.

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.flavor:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Infuriate
quotes.flavor:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

quotes.name: Bedrock Tortoise
quotes.flavor: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.

quotes.name: Flame of Anor
quotes.flavor: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.

quotes.name: Ancestral Statue
quotes.flavor: The mage awakened the statue in hopes of learning the lost lore of her clan, but the statue was interested only in war.

quotes.name: Gustcloak Savior
quotes.flavor:
"Our death-arrows flew in high arcs towards the aven. And then . . . nothing."
—Coliseum guard

quotes.name: Vanish from Sight
quotes.flavor: The Wanderer flung out her hand, but too late—Kaito had vanished into the House's maw.

quotes.name: Sidequest: Hunt the Mark // Yiazmat, Ultimate Mark
quotes.flavor: Legend says it is an Anima, guardian to a sacred blade. Though most sacred amongst its kind, its great power drove it to madness, and in the end, it became a threat to its own creator.

quotes.name: Floodhound
quotes.flavor: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.

quotes.name: Triumph of the Hordes
quotes.flavor:
「避けられる死もあれば、免れようのない死もある。」
――「戦呪文概要」

quotes.name: Tymaret, the Murder King
quotes.flavor: His memories remained in the Underworld, but his cruelty crossed the Rivers with him.

quotes.name: Armadillo Cloak
quotes.flavor:
"Don't laugh. It works."
—Yavimaya ranger

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: Catapult Master
quotes.flavor: "There's no 'I' in 'team,' but there's a 'we' in 'weapon.'"

quotes.name: Curse of Stalked Prey
quotes.flavor:
"Innocent thorns can fill the air with your bloodscent. Don't stray from the path."
—Elmut, crossway watcher

quotes.name: Fire Covenant
quotes.flavor: "On a failed save, target creature becomes a pile of fine gray dust."

quotes.name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a day when you feel crushed by the burden of modern life and your bright spirit will fade before a growing emptiness. When that happens, my dear, you'll be ready for this gift."
—Grandpa

quotes.name: Wormfang Turtle
quotes.flavor: Chainer's admirers keep his dreams alive.

quotes.name: Devout Chaplain
quotes.flavor: "By Avacyn's decree, we shall cleanse these relics of their demonic past."

quotes.name: Mistwalker
quotes.flavor:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

quotes.name: Shadow of Mortality
quotes.flavor:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall

quotes.name: Auramancer
quotes.flavor: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

quotes.name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
quotes.flavor: All are welcome.

quotes.name: Nature's Revolt
quotes.flavor: The land rises up to defend against those who would spoil its beauty.

quotes.name: Blood Moon
quotes.flavor: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

quotes.name: Shardless Agent
quotes.flavor: "The left blade for a swift, painless death. The right blade for a long, lingering one. The choice is mine."

quotes.name: Glorious Enforcer
quotes.flavor: "You are unworthy of life, but take heart. You have earned a clean death."

quotes.name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector // Hauken's Insight
quotes.flavor: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Xun Yu, Wei Advisor
quotes.flavor: "A splendid talent, admired of all men! His folly lay in serving Cao Cao's power."
